title: Home-Tutoring Services Assisted with Technology: Investigating the Role of Artificial Intelligence Using a Randomized Field Experiment
design_notes: Randomized controlled trial with regional pairs: AI-generated reports available to tutors in 5 treatment regions from one date (period 0), 5 control regions. DiD models: Eq. 1 event-study with Treat x period dummies (j=-5..3, baseline -1) plus controls X and region FE; Eq. 2 Treat, After, Treat x After with controls and region FE (Table 2 col 1, 14,122 obs); Eq. 3 adds student FE (Table 2 col 2, Treat x After = .096, SE .012). Table 7 (expanded sample, 6,330 obs): first-week viewers vs. viewers from week 7 on, After and Treat x After with student and tutor FE; again one treatment date. Matched (PSM) sample also used.
eligible_reason: All treated units start on one date (single adoption date, randomized assignment); main specifications include time-varying student/tutor controls and region FE and use a After indicator rather than calendar-time FE; PSM used for matched sample; IV appears for treatment on the treated.
screener_notes: Data from a private education company in South Korea; no data availability statement or package. Table 7 robustness is a two-group, one-date comparison (early vs. late viewers), so not staggered either.
screened_from: article text only (no package_dir or regressions file in batch_t2_004)
